retrievalProfile.description: A tight, multi-subject portrait with stacked, condensed sans-serif typography positioned in the negative space between faces.
triggerTerms: stacked condensed yellow and white text

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, candid-style group portrait of three people with a shallow depth of field, featuring a distinct 1960s analog film texture and a vertical column of right-aligned, condensed sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Faces framing a central vertical axis of text
Warm skin tones against a muted, neutral background
Contrast between yellow and white typographic blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a triangular formation, filling the frame with heads at varying heights and depths.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female subject's face, which occupies the lower-middle portion of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large profile on the left, down to the central face, then up to the text and the third face on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The narrow vertical gap between the two male subjects at the top right serves as the container for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural skin tones and muted beige/grey background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in hair and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow and stark white for typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on the text and skin.
paletteRestrictions: No neon or vibrant primary colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy within a single condensed font family.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Matches the clean, mid-century Swiss aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight, candid 1960s-style film photograph of three people (two men with beards, one blonde woman) in a close-up group portrait. Use muted colors and visible film grain. Leave a vertical gap of negative space in the upper right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, stacked uppercase text in an extra-condensed sans-serif font. Use pale yellow for the top three lines and white for the bottom two lines.

verificationChecks: Is the photo grain consistent with 60s film?
Are the colors for the text pale yellow and white?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the text does not overlap facial features
Ensure the grain is uniform across the image
Confirm the right-alignment of the text block
recipe.reuseFormula: Tight 60s film portrait + stacked condensed sans-serif + right-aligned negative space placement.
